superseding_details.unit_reference: 48 units in the taller of the two buildings are no longer being sought for residential use (Flats 5-10, 17-23, 30-36, 43- 49, 50-56, 57-63, 64-70), rather hotel use.
superseding_details.component_description: The current two existing buildings remain, the taller of the two fronting Hampton Court road is no longer proposed to be a residential use rather the proposal is to change it's use to hotel.

description: Change of Use of the building from student accommodation to provide 22 apartments (C3 Use Class) including 8 affordable units and a 90-bed hotel (Use Class C1). Façade and elevational alterations, infill extension at ground floor level and associated landscaping, widening of two crossovers, access, parking/refuse provision and other external alterations.
